text:
alex: Heads-up — we need to lock the API launch gates for the new SDK/docs push next sprint. ACME (pilot) is pushing structured-output + function-calling use cases, and they need examples and typed clients.

maria: +1. Prioritize type defs and clear TS/Py examples. If we have to cut scope, drop rerank for MVP.

john: Agree. Also need perf targets for embeddings and streaming. We should require a perf bench in CI.

sofia: From PM side — launch criteria: migration guide, changelog, example app, and an ops playbook for Dedicated/Private customers.

devon: Proposal: 3-phase rollout
- MVP: chat/completions + embeddings + minimal function-calling (sync)
- Beta: structured-output types + full function calling (tool schema), typed examples (TS/Py)
- GA: rerank + advanced batching configs + canary routing

mike: I can own TS type defs. preference: explicit typed clients vs overloads. quick idea:

```ts
export type Invoice = {id: string; total_cents: number}
export interface Client { generate<T>(prompt: string): Promise<T> }
```

maria: +owner for changelog and examples? we need a sample repo app for ACME flows.

doc-bot: checklist created: 1) types PR 2) examples repo 3) changelog entry 4) migration guide 5) perf bench

doc-bot: https://go/repo/checklist/1719203045

john: tests: add e2e harness that runs against hosted + dedicated; perf target: p95 token latency < 150ms for typical chat size.

sofia: Launch criteria (draft):
- End-to-end example app that demonstrates structured output + function-calling
- TS + Py examples with types and small migration note
- Changelog entry + migration guide
- Automated perf benchmarks and blocking tests
- Docs page with rollout notes and fallback behavior

alex: OK — owners: mike (TS types) by 1719800000, maria (examples + changelog) by 1719850000, john (perf + e2e) by 1719820000, devon (rollout plan) by 1719900000. I'll schedule a 30m alignment tomorrow to hand off scoping.

mike: noted. will open a draft PR for types today.

maria: adding docs outline to docs board :memo:

alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
